subject: BridgePoint - Service Assurance Appendix & Audit Schedule
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@bridgepointfinancial.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Service assurance appendix + audit day options

Hi Marissa / Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — appreciated the deep dive on routing/fallbacks and the Dedicated offering. As part of our procurement review for BridgePoint's vendor risk team we need a concise "service assurance appendix" that calls out operational controls, audit artifacts, and a proposed schedule for a limited audit/interview day. Key asks from our side: 

- Short description of network isolation options (VPC/private deployment).
- Evidence types you can provide (SOC 2 report, encryption attestations, audit logs, retention windows).
- Who would be BridgePoint's contacts for any technical interviews and the suggested duration (we're planning a 4-hour onsite/virtual audit window).
- Any non-negotiable SLA or data residency constraints.

Can you send a single PDF appendix and a draft schedule by EOD Monday? Attaching our standard RFI matrix for mapping (see attachment: BridgePoint_RFI_Matrix.xlsx).

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
BridgePoint Financial

Attachment: BridgePoint_RFI_Matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@bridgepointfinancial.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Service assurance appendix + audit day options

Lena — thanks for the clear asks. I've attached a Service Assurance Appendix that summarizes the items you listed and includes short control mappings to common FFIEC-style categories (availability, change management, access control, encryption, vendor governance). High-level notes here: 

- Deployment options: Hosted (Redwood API), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools), Private (VPC or on-prem package). Private deployments include customer-managed networking and KMS/HSM integrations for key custody.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (we can share redacted reports under NDA), retained audit logs (90 days by default, configurable to 1 year for enterprise), weekly snapshots of model-serving metrics, and change records.
- DR/Resilience: DR runbook, RTO targets we design per-customer (typical SLO: 99.9% regional availability for Dedicated), incremental KV-cache warmup guidance for failover.
- Security controls: TLS-in-transit, AES-256 at rest for hosted metadata, role-based access controls for console and token scoping, and per-token cost/latency tracing for auditability.

Proposed audit/interview options (please confirm):
- Option A: Remote 4-hour technical window (2 hours infra/ops, 2 hours product/controls) — preferred week of June 8.
- Option B: Split sessions across two half-days the week of June 8–12.

Suggested Redwood attendees: myself (account lead, will coordinate), Aditya Rao (compliance & product controls), Karthik Iyer (technical lead — infra/runtime). Please confirm which option works and any preferred timezones.

I attached: BridgePoint_RFI_SA_Appendix_v1.pdf (single-file appendix) and included inline a brief control table. If you need SOC 2 evidence we will request an NDA signature via DocuSign.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: BridgePoint_RFI_SA_Appendix_v1.pdf (PDF, 430KB)

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@bridgepointfinancial.com>

Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Service assurance appendix + audit day options

Marissa — appreciate the quick turnaround and the appendix. A couple of follow-ups after an internal skim: 

1) Can you add a one-page control mapping (control ID -> Redwood artifact/source) for the following FFIEC categories: Incident Response, Configuration Management, Logical Access, Data Protection? We don't need full artifacts at this stage, just the mapping so our reviewers know where to look in the appendix.

2) For the audit day, we prefer Option A (single 4-hour remote block on June 10). Can you confirm the names and titles of the Redwood attendees and provide an agenda (30m intros, 90m infra/deep-dive, 60m controls/Q&A, 40m open items and next steps).

3) One operational ask: we note that retention defaults are 90 days — would Redwood support a contractual 180-day audit-log retention for our Dedicated environment? If there are cost implications please flag them.

Thanks — if you can send an annotated appendix with the mapping and a draft agenda by EOD Wednesday that'll keep us on track for procurement.

Tom / Lena — thanks, we'll take Option A on June 10 and deliver the requested artifacts. Actions below and attachments included: 

1) Control mapping: added a 1-page mapping table (Control_Mapping_Table, first tab of BridgePoint_RFI_SA_Appendix_v1.pdf). That maps Incident Response, Configuration Management, Logical Access, and Data Protection to Redwood artifacts (runbooks, change logs, IAM role audit, encryption key policy).

2) Audit day attendees / agenda: 
- 09:00–09:30 PT: Introductions & procurement checklist — Marissa Cole (Account Lead).
- 09:30–11:00 PT: Infrastructure & runtime deep-dive — Karthik Iyer (Principal Infra Engineer).
- 11:00–12:00 PT: Controls, evidence, and compliance processes — Aditya Rao (Head of Compliance).
- 12:00–12:40 PT: Open items, follow-ups, next steps.

3) Retention: We can support a 180-day audit-log retention on Dedicated as a contractual change. There will be a small incremental storage charge; we'll include pricing in the contract addendum. If you prefer we can scope a 365-day option as well.

4) Next steps: I've attached SLA-terms-redlines.docx with initial redline suggestions for your review. Please confirm the June 10 time slot (we propose 09:00–13:00 PT) and we'll send calendar invites + a DocuSign NDA link for SOC 2 access.
